Validated observations: Rollback claims can contradict restore instructions: Source-control and safe-point receipts require rollback_available and restore_command_or_action but do not bind the boolean to a non-empty, usable action. | WorkNodes may complete without proof and with unresolved findings: worknode_completion_receipt does not condition terminal_status=complete on non-empty change, test, and source-control receipts or on unresolved_findings being empty. | Certified goals may violate every completion invariant: goal_completion_receipt lists completion booleans and a certifier decision but has no conditional that makes the invariants true when final_certifier_decision is certified.
features.title: Source Control And Completion Receipts

features.gap_summary: Validated gaps or unknowns: Rollback availability can be asserted without a recovery route; Source-control state vocabularies lack a declared mapping; Authority level does not bound mutation policy.
features.summary: Normalized local concept for source-control-safety-and-rollback. Validated observations: Rollback availability can be asserted without a recovery route: source_control_context requires rollback_available, rollback_ref, and restore_command_or_action but does not condition their nullability or nonemptiness on rollback availability. | Source-control state vocabularies lack a declared mapping: source_control_dirty_state and branch_head_state overlap on clean, dirty, conflicted, and unknown but the window defines no normalization or precedence rule between them. | Authority level does not bound mutation policy: The authority object requires authority_level and mutation_policy but does not constrain valid combinations or require escalation for restricted levels.
features.title: Source Control Safety And Rollback

instructions.domain_rule: All provisional features must retain owner_domain=source_control_workspace_code; cross-domain concepts become cross_domain_terms or relationships, never merges.
instructions.membership_rule: Every assigned local_feature_ref must have exactly one membership and appear in exactly one provisional_feature.local_feature_refs list.
instructions.merge_rule: Merge only when concepts are the same product feature under the same authority/lifecycle. Shared vocabulary or adjacency is not enough.
instructions.objective: Deduplicate true synonyms within this one owner domain while preserving distinct lifecycles, authorities, consumers, states, failures, gaps, and explicit non-gaps.
instructions.output_rule: Write exactly one strict-schema JSON payload in the assigned output directory, then return PMR1.
instructions.provenance_rule: Source documents and source-unit refs in each provisional feature must equal the union from its member local features.
instructions.research_lineage_rule: Research/scenario obligations remain in the immutable local-feature ledger and will be mechanically unioned after domain reduction; do not invent external evidence here.
instructions.split_rule: Keep distinct features when authority, lifecycle, consumer, state machine, failure/recovery, security boundary, or user-visible promise differs.
